## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `Deinon_*_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Deinon_*_x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `Deinon_*_x64-setup.exe`, or the `.msi` |
| Linux, Debian or Ubuntu | `Deinon_*_amd64.deb` |
| Linux, other | `Deinon_*_amd64.AppImage` |

These builds are not code-signed, so your system will warn you the first time. The README explains how to open them on each system. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for each file.
